tasks.title: Docs: CLAUDE.md and README.md for the round-17 changes
tasks.description:
Update the docs to match what this round shipped. Docs only — no code changes.

In CLAUDE.md:
1. Development — `bun run typecheck` now covers `src/` AND `test/`; remove the paragraph about `test/`'s ~43 pre-existing type errors being deferred.
2. Enforcement under /cairn-run — the reviewer's Bash scope now denies any command containing `$` (shell expansion, subsuming `$(`, `${…}`, `$VAR`, `$'…'`), with the exact-token `--output` check kept as a second layer; and the hook now resolves the project by walking up from the tool call's `cwd`, ignoring `CAIRN_PROJECT_ROOT`, falling back to the env var only when the payload has no usable `cwd` (including for the error-log path).
3. Replace the "Remaining headless gap" paragraph: the headless reviewer now spawns with `--disallowedTools`, a probe established that deny wildcards DO match an argument mid-command, and the residual limit is that deny patterns match raw text while the hook parses the command — so the hook stays the stronger layer.
4. Per-project data layout — `cairn init` now adds missing entries to an existing `.cairn/.gitignore` (append-only, never reorders or removes).
5. Run state — merge the two duplicated bullets ("Picking records the sha under the lock" and "Orphan pruning") into the bullets above them that already say the same thing.

In README.md: matching updates to the reviewer-containment line (~line 167) and the `.gitignore` / `cairn init` lines (~lines 105, 381).

Do NOT modify `cairn.json`'s `healthCheck` value and do NOT modify `package.json`'s `build` script — the binary is pinned for this round and the health check is redirected to /tmp/cairn-healthcheck. Do NOT run `./install.sh`. `cairn.json` has an uncommitted user change: stage only the files you changed.
tasks.notes:
# Task #123 — Docs: CLAUDE.md and README.md for the round-17 changes

Docs-only change, no code touched. Confirmed via `git diff HEAD -- CLAUDE.md` that item 1
(typecheck now covers `src/` and `test/`) was already reflected in the working tree (a prior
round-17 task had already updated it), so no edit was needed there.

## CLAUDE.md changes

1. **Enforcement under /cairn-run — reviewer Bash scope**: updated the `agent_type:
   post-task-reviewer` bullet to describe the new `$`-anywhere denial (`/[`<>$]/` in
   `isInspectionOnly`, `src/commands/hook.ts`), which subsumes `$(...)`, `${VAR}`, bare `$VAR`,
   and `$'...'` ANSI-C quoting, and explains the hole it closes (`--output${X}=` surviving the
   old strip-then-compare). Kept the exact-token `--output`/`--output=<file>` check
   (`hasOutputOption`) as the documented second layer, noting it no longer strips `$` itself.
2. **Replaced the "Remaining headless gap" paragraph** with "Headless reviewer containment":
   documents `spawnPostTaskReviewer`'s new `--disallowedTools` argument
   (`REVIEWER_DISALLOWED_BASH_RULES` in `src/claude-settings.ts`: `Bash(*--output*)`,
   `Bash(*--out*)`, `Bash(*$*)`, `` Bash(*") ``, `Bash(*')`), the planning-round probe that
   established a deny wildcard DOES match an argument mid-command (with the exact probe
   commands/results quoted from the task-completion notes and the `claude-settings.ts` doc
   comment), and the residual accepted limit (deny matches raw text; the hook parses the
   command, so it stays the stronger layer).
3. **Per-project data layout**: `.gitignore` tree line now says re-init appends any entries
   missing from an existing file, never reorders/removes (matches `mergeGitignoreEntries` in
   `src/commands/init.ts`).
4. **Run state**: merged the "Picking records the sha under the lock" bullet into the
   "re-pick keeps the first attempt's beforeSha" bullet above it, and merged "Orphan pruning"
   into the "Settle clears/keeps the record" bullet above it (both duplicates removed; no
   information lost — the lock detail and the "never `awaiting-review`" clause were folded in).

## README.md changes

- Reviewer-containment bullet (`#### Containment under /cairn-run`, was ~line 167): now
  describes denying redirection/backticks/`$` anywhere (with the subsumption list) plus the
  `--output` exact-token check as a second layer, matching the CLAUDE.md wording.
- `.gitignore` / `cairn init` line ~105 ("Cairn deliberately does not edit `.gitignore`..."):
  clarified this refers to the project's *root* `.gitignore` (for `.claude/settings.local.json`),
  and added a parenthetical distinguishing it from `.cairn/.gitignore`, which `cairn init` does
  write and, on re-init, appends missing entries to — linked to the "Per-project data" section.
- `.gitignore` tree line ~381 (Per-project data diagram): added "re-init appends any missing
  entries, never reorders/removes", matching the CLAUDE.md tree line.

## Verification

- `bun run typecheck` — clean.
- `bun test` — 1217 pass, 0 fail.
- Confirmed facts by reading `src/commands/init.ts` (`mergeGitignoreEntries`,
  `currentGitignoreEntries`), `src/commands/hook.ts` (`isInspectionOnly`, `hasOutputOption`),
  `src/post-task-reviewer.ts` (`spawnPostTaskReviewer`'s `--disallowedTools` arg), and
  `src/claude-settings.ts` (`REVIEWER_DISALLOWED_BASH_RULES` doc comment with the probe
  results), plus the completed task descriptions/notes for tasks #117, #118, and #121 in
  `.cairn/tasks.completed.json` for the exact probe wording.

## Scope notes

- Did not touch `cairn.json` or `package.json`'s build script (round-17 binary pin / health
  check redirect left untouched).
- Did not run `./install.sh`, `cairn round …`, or `cairn hook …` against this repo's root.
- `cairn.json` had a pre-existing uncommitted user change, unrelated to this task — left
  unstaged, staged only `CLAUDE.md` and `README.md` (plus `.cairn/tasks.json` via `cairn task
  complete`) for this commit.
- This was task #123, the last task of round 17 (0 remaining tasks after this one).
